;;;; Shipping rates. Stubs make the file loadable with plain sbcl.

(defpackage #:kc6.rates (:use #:cl))
(in-package #:kc6.rates)

(defun shipping-rate (kind base)
  (cond ((eq kind :standard) base)
        ((eq kind :express) (* base 3/2))
        ((eq kind :bulk) (* base 9/10))
        (t (error "unknown kind ~s" kind))))

(defun read-forms (path)
  (with-open-file (in path)
    (loop for form = (read in nil in) until (eq form in) collect form)))

(defun fail (why) (format t "FAIL: ~a~%" why) (sb-ext:exit :code 1))

(let* ((forms (handler-case (read-forms "rates.lisp")
                (error (c) (fail (format nil "rates.lisp does not read: ~a" c)))))
       (defun-form (find-if (lambda (f) (and (consp f) (eq (first f) 'defun)))
                            forms))
       (body (cdddr defun-form))
       (cond-form (first body)))
  (unless (and (consp cond-form) (eq (first cond-form) 'cond))
    (fail "shipping-rate's body is not a single cond"))
  (let ((clauses (rest cond-form)))
    (unless (= 5 (length clauses)) (fail (format nil "cond has ~d clauses, want 5" (length clauses))))
    (unless (equal (first clauses) '((eq kind :standard) base)) (fail "clause 1 changed"))
    (unless (equal (second clauses) '((eq kind :express) (* base 3/2))) (fail "clause 2 changed"))
    (unless (equal (third clauses) '((eq kind :bulk) (* base 9/10))) (fail "clause 3 changed"))
    (unless (equal (fourth clauses) '((eq kind :overnight) (* base 2)))
      (fail (format nil "clause 4 is ~s, want ((eq kind :overnight) (* base 2))" (fourth clauses))))
    (unless (eq t (first (fifth clauses))) (fail "the t clause is no longer last"))))
(format t "ok~%")
